subject: Stage ownership roll-call + forecast readying for Oct close
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: revops@consultants.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stage ownership roll-call + forecast readying for Oct close

Team —

Quick reminder as we head into the final two reporting weeks for October: we need stage ownership confirmed and committed amounts reconciled so FP&A can finalize the forecast and leadership can assemble a clean review deck. Please do the following by EOD Wednesday (10/21):

- Update your owned opportunities in the pipeline tracker (column: Stage Owner, Commit/Tentative, Close Prob)
- Attach a one-line status note for any >$250k deals (reason for slip, next milestone, blocker owner)
- Flag any deals that should be moved to Commit but need leadership approval (put "LEAD REVIEW" in the notes)

I attached a stage_update_template.xlsx to make this fast. We'll consolidate into the leadership_deck_notes.md and the pipeline_summary_oct.csv which RevOps will use for the deck.

If you anticipate not hitting the EOD Wed deadline, reply here with what you can deliver and when.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: stage_update_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 12KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage ownership roll-call + forecast readying for Oct close

Thanks Irene — tagging my book of business. Quick notes:

- I updated the tracker for my 6 opportunities; two need more validation on timing (marked Tentative).
- Added a 1-line note for ACME Cloud (> $400k) with the current procurement timeline and PO risk.
- Pushed the stage_update_template back with my rows filled (see attachment).

Irene: can you confirm whether Leadership wants the deck to call out any deals where legal redlines are outstanding? I can add a short Legal status column if helpful.

Best,
Laura

Redwood Inference

Attachment: stage_update_template_filled_laura.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 18KB)

Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Stage ownership roll-call + forecast readying for Oct close

Looping in a quick question — for any deals marked "LEAD REVIEW", what is the preferred approval path? Last quarter we routed approvals through Sales Leadership + FP&A review, but if Ops wants to triage technical or security blockers up front, we should note that.

If possible, can RevOps (Irene) create a one-slide summary for each LEAD REVIEW item with:
- value
- reason for escalation
- proposed next step and approver

I can start that for two items but will need the one-line notes Laura asked people to add.

Thanks,
Karthik
SVP, Sales

Appreciate the fast responses — solid progress. A few clarifications and next steps:

- Yes, please include a Legal status column for any deals >$250k with outstanding redlines. That helps leadership see risk at a glance.
- For "LEAD REVIEW" items: route to Sales Leadership + FP&A simultaneously. RevOps will prepare the one-slide escalation summary (Karthik, I'll draft the first two) and put them in the Drive folder under /oct-pipeline-readying/escals/.
- Deadline reminder: final tracker updates by EOD Wed 10/21 (I need to hand the consolidated CSV to Finance at 9am PT Thu).

I'll assemble the leadership_deck_notes.md and export pipeline_summary_oct.csv after combing the updates. If anyone needs an extension, reply here with what you can complete and the specific gaps (amounts, PO date, legal status).

Thanks —
Irene
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
